_rule: What the signer WASM may call: each import of konclave_wasm_bg.wasm and the body the glue gives it. Regenerate with `node scripts/check-wasm-pkg.mjs ui/src/wasm-pkg --write-allowlist` and review every changed body. A body that reaches the network, storage, workers or messaging is refused. A reflective import (Reflect.*, eval, Function, a getter or setter of an arbitrary property) needs the security auditor's review before it is added, because with one the module reaches anything on globalThis without any name saying so. The same review applies to a new import that reads a property which can hold a function (for example .fetch, .then, .subtle, .constructor): `__wbg_call_*` invokes any function the module holds, so one such getter gives it everything.
